opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search with date, route and sort
opportunities.description: Search one-way or round-trip flights on jetblue.com by entering origin and destination airports/cities, departure (and optional return) dates, then sort results by price.
steps: Open jetblue.com flights booking page.
If the trip type is not the one needed, open the Roundtrip dropdown and choose Roundtrip or One-way.
Click the From field, clear it, type the origin city, and pick the matching airport or metro entry from the dropdown.
Click the To field, type the destination city, and pick the matching entry.
Click Depart and choose the departure date in the calendar.
For round trips, click Return and choose the return date.
Click Search flights.
If an interstitial appears (e.g. 'Flying today, right?' or 'You may need proof of return travel'), click Continue to flight results.
Open Sort & Filter, choose a sort option (e.g. Price low to high or Price by Core), optionally tick airport filters, then click Apply.
Read the resulting flight list.

instances.values: Origin New York JFK (replacing default Columbus Port Columbus), destination Miami MIA, roundtrip, depart Mar 27, return Mar 31; then results were sorted by Points and 'Price by Core' (t≈1143–1160).

Origin New York City area NYC, destination Toronto YYZ, one-way (switched from Roundtrip), depart Apr 29; results sorted Price (low to high) with LGA and JFK departure airports ticked, applied at t≈1741.
Origin New York City area NYC, destination Aruba AUA, roundtrip, depart May 1, return May 5; Use TrueBlue points ticked and results sorted Price (low to high) at t≈2430–2439.

opportunities.name: United car rental search by pickup location, dates and times
opportunities.description: Search for a rental car on united.com by entering a pickup city, pickup and drop-off dates, and pickup/drop-off times, then clicking Find cars.
steps: Open united.com and click the CAR tab in the booking widget.
Click the Pickup location field, type the city, and choose the matching location from the dropdown.
Click Rental dates Pickup and choose the pickup date in the calendar.
Click the Drop off date and choose the return date.
Open the Pickup time dropdown and select the time.
Open the Drop off time dropdown and select the time.
Leave or tick 'Return car to same location' and 'Book with miles' as required.
Click Find cars.

instances.values: Pickup Caldwell (Ohio), US; Apr 08 to Apr 13; pickup 8:00 a.m., drop-off 12:00 p.m.; Find cars clicked at ~1095.
Pickup Brooklyn - Central (New York), US; Apr 09 to Apr 15; pickup 10:00 a.m., drop-off 10:00 a.m.; Find cars clicked at ~1890.

opportunities.name: Avis Budget careers job search by country, team and time type
opportunities.description: Reach the Avis Budget Group Openings page and filter job listings by keyword, country, team and time type, then open a listing.
steps: Open the Budget site footer and click Careers (or go to the Avis Budget Group Openings page).
Click the Openings link on the Avis careers page.
Optionally type a keyword in 'Search by job title or keyword'.
Click the Country field and choose the country.
Click the Team field and choose the team (e.g. Finance).
Click the Time Type field and choose Full time or Part time.
Click 'Search by job title or keyword'.
Click a job title in the results to open its detail page, and click Apply Now if needed.

instances.values: Keyword blank, Country United States of America, Team Finance, Time Type Full time; 26 matching jobs; opened 'Accounts Payable Associate' (Virginia Beach).
Keyword blank, Country United States of America, Team Finance, Time Type Full time; results then showed Hawaii and other locations (search completed at ~2818).

opportunities.name: NPS Find a Park filter by activity or topic
opportunities.description: On nps.gov Find a Park, choose one or more Activity or Topic filters from the dropdown checklists, run Search, and review the matching parks.
steps: Open nps.gov Find a Park page.
Click the By Activity dropdown (or By Topic dropdown) and tick the desired activity or topic checkbox(es).
Click Search.
Scroll the results list and read the park names and states.

instances.values: Activity set to Junior Ranger Program; Search clicked; 470 results total.
Topic set to Industry, Laborer and Worker; Search clicked; 470 results total.

opportunities.name: MTA toll rates navigation by vehicle type
opportunities.description: Navigate the MTA site to the Bridges and Tunnels toll pages and open the rate page for a chosen vehicle type.
steps: Open mta.info and go to Fares & Tolls (or open the Menu and go to Agencies).
Open Bridges and Tunnels tolls (or choose Bridges & Tunnels from the agency list).
Click Tolls by vehicle (or Toll Rates).
Click the tile for the vehicle type (Cars, Motorcycles, Trucks).

instances.values: Menu > Agencies > Bridges & Tunnels > Tolls by vehicle > Cars.
Fares & Tolls > Bridges and Tunnels tolls > Toll Rates > Motorcycles (Motorcycle Toll Rates page).

opportunities.name: Online store keyword product search with price range and result review
opportunities.description: Search an e-commerce or shopping site for a product by keyword, optionally set a min/max price or sort, and open or compare a result.
steps: Click the site's main search box and type the product keyword.
Press Enter or click the search icon.
If available, enter a max (and optional min) price in the price filter and click Go.
Review the results and click a product, Compare prices, or Add to Cart.
If a variation is required, choose it before adding to cart.
parameters: product to open or add to cart

instances.values: Menards: keyword 'swivel vacuum', max price 150, product added to cart.
Google Shopping: keyword 'granitestone sandwich maker', opened Compare 10+ prices, applied Free delivery filter.
Amazon: keyword 'wireless headphones', opened a sponsored result and clicked Add to Cart.
